composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-114a, "BILGE SYSTEM") serves the vessel's bilge equipment: the Main Bilge Pump (top-left motor symbol, fed via F3 60A/SW8/SO6, with local pump switch and control taps from T/S S), the Bilge Valves bank (six identical "BILGE VALVE ENG. ROOM BILGE"-captioned motorised valve controllers wired through T/S C to Re1–Re6 and the Main Panel), and the Bilge Level Switches / monitoring loop (Port/Stbd Lazarette, Aft, Eng Room, Fwd, Sail Locker bilge switches feeding status to Main Panel PLUG C / PC CARD indicator lamps). The Main Panel itself (S20–S24, S13, PLUG C, PLUG D, PC CARD, ALARM MOD/PEDESTAL) is the monitoring/control head-end for these loads and attaches to 641-vessel-control-panel as shared infrastructure, not to any single bilge device.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Top-right motor symbol explicitly labelled 'MAIN BILGE PUMP'; fed from F3 60A / SW8 / SO6 at top-left, with local pump switch (LOCAL PUMP SW) and T/S S control terminals 13/14/15 — matches established multi-switch activation control_loop already on this node from prior composition pass.

functions.label: Run main bilge pump on demand from any authorised station
functions.what_it_does: Drives the main bilge pump motor to evacuate bilge water; can be started locally at the pump station, from the Main Panel switch, or remotely via ONYX.

flow_scenarios.path: +24V supply -> F3 60A fuse -> SW8 -> SO6 -> T/S S terminal 13/14/15 -> relay coil de-energised -> pump motor off
LOCAL PUMP SW (contact 1/2 at T/S S) -> T/S S terminals 13/14 -> relay coil energised -> contactor closes -> +24V -> MAIN BILGE PUMP motor -> ground return
Main Panel switch S13 (BILGE PUMP SW) -> PLUG C pins 6/7 -> T/S S/relay coil -> contactor closes -> MAIN BILGE PUMP motor runs
ONYX remote command (via 'to ONYX' pointer near Re6/XA1) -> relay coil -> contactor closes -> MAIN BILGE PUMP motor runs

functions.dry_data: Feed: F3 60A fuse, SW8 switch, SO6 breaker/isolator; control via T/S S terminals 13/14/15; established control_loop confirms 3 alternative activation paths (local/main panel/ONYX).

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Six identical valve-controller blocks each captioned 'BILGE VALVE ENG. ROOM BILGE' with OPEN/CLOSE contact pairs and [2]/[3] motor terminals, wired through T/S C (terminals 1-50) and relays Re1-Re5 to the Main Panel PLUG C / PC CARD open/closed indicators — matches register 'BILGE VALVES -> 520-bilge-valves' mapping.

functions.label: Open/close motorised bilge valve for a bilge zone (repeated per zone: Lazarette/Aft/Eng Room/Fwd/Sail Locker)
functions.what_it_does: Each valve controller opens or closes its bilge line valve on command from the Main Panel, and reports open/closed status back to the Main Panel PC card indicator lamps.
functions.sheet_region: controller_module bbox [0.55,0.25,0.72,0.78] — six OPEN/CLOSE contact + motor valve blocks along T/S C

flow_scenarios.path: T/S C terminals (per zone pair, e.g. 7/8, 16/17, 24/25, 32/33, 40/41) idle -> valve motor [2]/[3] de-energised -> valve holds last position
Main Panel OPEN switch -> PLUG C pin -> T/S C terminal (odd of pair) -> relay (Re1-Re5) contact -> valve motor terminal [2] -> valve opens -> status line -> bilge switch/PC card 'open' indicator lamp
Main Panel CLOSE switch -> PLUG C pin -> T/S C terminal (even of pair) -> relay contact -> valve motor terminal [3] -> valve closes -> status line -> PC card 'closed' indicator lamp

functions.dry_data: 6 valve controllers, each with OPEN/CLOSE contact pair and 2-wire motor drive ([2]/[3]); relay-driven from T/S C via Re1-Re5; wire-gauge diamonds on T/S C are callouts, not devices.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Bilge level switches (Port/Stbd Lazarette, Aft, Eng Room, Fwd, Sail Locker BILGE SW) are wired directly off the same valve/T/S C loop and report status to the Main Panel/PC card; no separate 'Vega bilge level sensors' node fits this vendor-agnostic status wiring, so grouped with the bilge valves system as the closest fitting node (status side of the same zone loop). Uncertainty noted below.

functions.label: Report high-bilge-water status per zone to Main Panel
functions.what_it_does: Each float/level switch signals wet-bilge condition for its zone back to the Main Panel PC card and drives an alarm via the ALARM MOD / PEDESTAL ALARM+MUTE module.
functions.sheet_region: other region bbox [0.75,0.3,0.92,0.78] — 6 bilge level switches (PORT/STBD LAZARETTE, AFT, ENG ROOM, FWD, SAIL LOCKER)

flow_scenarios.path: BILGE SW float switch open -> status line quiescent -> no alarm at PC card
BILGE SW float switch closes -> status line -> T/S C tap -> Main Panel PC card indicator/diode array -> PEDESTAL ALARM+MUTE module sounds alarm (mute available at pedestal)

functions.dry_data: Float/level switch per zone, +/- 2-wire tap into T/S C status lines; alarm output routed to PEDESTAL ALARM+MUTE and PC card diode array (+24V).

infrastructure.system_name: Main Panel / PLUG C / PLUG D / PC CARD monitoring head-end
facts: PLUG C (7 pins) carries Lazarette/Aft/Eng Room/Fwd/Sail Locker bilge open-close commands and status to switches S20-S24
S13 is the Main Panel BILGE PUMP SW feeding the main bilge pump control loop
PLUG D (12 pins) feeds the PC CARD open/closed indicator lamps for each zone plus +24V and diode array
AUX PLUG ON PC BOARD taps [8]->[1], [9]->[2], [10]->[3], [11]->[4] are internal PC-board cross-links, not separate field wiring
PEDESTAL ALARM+MUTE module (12-pin) provides audible alarm and mute function for the bilge monitoring loop, wired via its own terminal pins 1-12 to PLUG D/PC CARD area

infrastructure.system_name: T/S C main terminal strip (bilge valve/switch distribution, terminals 1-50)
facts: 50-way terminal strip distributing OPEN/CLOSE commands and status lines between Main Panel, relays Re1-Re6, and the six bilge valve/switch zones

XA40 taps (terminals 14,12,16) and XA10 taps (terminals 06,04,02) and XA11 tap (32) are monitoring-loom cross-references off T/S C — direction (status out vs command in) could not be confirmed from drawn lines alone
T/S B (terminals 8-13) hosts relay coils Re1-Re6 bridging T/S C to the field devices
'to ONYX' annotation near Re6/terminal 13 is a genuine off-sheet pointer to the ONYX monitoring system (652-onyx-monitoring), consistent with established main bilge pump control_loop

infrastructure.system_name: T/S S local pump switch terminal / feed
facts: 3-terminal strip (13/14/15) carrying the local pump switch signal and fused feed into the main bilge pump relay coil
Fed from F3 60A fuse, SW8 switch, SO6 isolator upstream on the +24V service battery rail

uncertainties: XA40/XA10/XA11 tap direction (status-out vs command-in) cannot be confirmed purely from the drawn lines on this sheet — flagged per signal-direction rule rather than assumed.

Bilge level switches have no dedicated vendor node in the register (e.g. no 'Vega bilge level sensors' equivalent under 520-); grouped under 520-bilge-valves as the closest fitting node since they share the same zone wiring loop — flag if a dedicated sensor node should exist.

T/S C terminal 49 connection role and terminals 48/50 loop-back purpose are not fully resolvable from the extraction (ambiguous bus/loop marks) — recorded as infrastructure fact only, no function invented.

Re6 relay's exact role (appears tied to 'to ONYX' pointer and an indicator lamp) is noted as part of the main bilge pump control loop per established facts, but its separate contact/indicator wiring on this sheet could not be fully walked to a distinct function beyond that.
